lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevee sabad suhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I serve the True Guru; the Word of His Shabad is beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through it, the Name of the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har niramal haumai mail gavaae dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Pure Lord removes the filth of egotism, and we are honored in the True Court. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur naam na paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, the Naam cannot be obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik rahe bilalaai ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas and the seekers lack it; they weep and wail.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur seve sukh na hovee poorai bhaag gur paavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained; through perfect destiny, the Guru is found. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਰਸੀ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man aarasee koee guramukh vekhai ||
lines.translation: This mind is a mirror; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, see themselves in it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਰਚਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: morachaa na laagai jaa haumai sokhai ||
lines.translation: Rust does not stick to those who burn their ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: anahat baanee niramal sabad vajaae gurasabadee sach samaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The Unstruck Melody of the Bani resounds through the Pure Word of the Shabad; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are absorbed into the True One. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur kihu na dekhiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, the Lord cannot be seen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa kar aap ditaa dikhaai ||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, He Himself has allowed me to see Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap aap mil rahiaa sahaje sahaj samaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: All by Himself, He Himself is permeating and pervading; He is intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s ikas siu liv laae ||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh embraces love for the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojaa bharam gur sabad jalaae ||
lines.translation: Doubt and duality are burned away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar vanaj kare vaapaaraa naam nidhaan sach paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Within his body, he deals and trades, and obtains the Treasure of the True Name. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh karanee har keerat saar ||
lines.translation: The life-style of the Gurmukh is sublime; he sings the Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh paae mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh finds the gate of salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: anadin ra(n)g rataa gun gaavai a(n)dar mahal bulaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Night and day, he is imbued with the Lord's Love. He sings the Lord's Glorious Praises, and he is called to the Mansion of His Presence. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur daataa milai milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Giver, is met when the Lord leads us to meet Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag man sabad vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through perfect destiny, the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੯॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee har sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||8||9||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by chanting the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||8||9||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap va(n)njaae taa sabh kichh paae ||
lines.translation: Those who lose their own selves obtain everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee sachee liv laae ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enshrine Love for the True one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਘਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach vana(n)jahi sach sa(n)gharahi sach vaapaar karaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: They trade in Truth, they gather in Truth, and they deal only in Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har gun anadin gaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau teraa too(n) thaakur meraa sabad vadiaaee devaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am Yours, You are my Lord and Master. You bestow greatness through the Word of Your Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: velaa vakhat sabh suhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: That time, that moment is totally beautiful,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit sachaa mere man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: when the True One becomes pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sache seviai sach vadiaaee gur kirapaa te sach paavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Serving the True One, true greatness is obtained. By Guru's Grace, the True One is obtained. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaau bhojan satigur tuthai paae ||
lines.translation: The food of spiritual love is obtained when the True Guru is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: an ras chookai har ras ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: Other essences are forgotten, when the Lord's Essence comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)tokh sahaj sukh baanee poore gur te paavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Truth, contentment and intuitive peace and poise are obtained from the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur na sevahi moorakh a(n)dh gavaaraa ||
lines.translation: The blind and ignorant fools do not serve the True Guru;

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਇ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir oi kithahu paain mokh duaaraa ||
lines.translation: how will they find the gate of salvation?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi phir phir aavahi jam dar chotaa khaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: They die and die, over and over again, only to be reborn, over and over again. They are struck down at Death's Door. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabadai saad jaanahi taa aap pachhaanahi ||
lines.translation: Those who know the essence of the Shabad, understand their own selves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal baanee sabad vakhaanahi ||
lines.translation: Immaculate is the speech of those who chant the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sache sev sadaa sukh paain nau nidh naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Serving the True One, they find a lasting peace; they enshrine the nine treasures of the Naam within their minds. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so thaan suhaaiaa jo har man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Beautiful is that place, which is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat bahi har gun gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: There, sitting in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: anadin har saalaahahi saachaa niramal naad vajaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Night and day, the True One is praised; the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad resounds there. ||6||
